results.content: Democratic candidates are leading their Republican opponents in three of Texas’s most competitive House races, according to a new poll released Wednesday. The Barbara Jordan Public Policy and Research and Survey Center at Texas Southern University conducted surveys among likely voters in the state’s 15th, 28th and 34th congressional districts. All three districts are located in the southern region of Texas and have a majority of Latino residents. In the state’s 34th District, which includes a large strip of the state’s coast, Democratic Rep. Vicente Gonzalez had a 3-point advantage over his GOP opponent, Eric Flores.
